Ingredients: Basmati rice, Chicken or mutton, Yogurt, Onions, Tomatoes, Ginger-garlic paste, Biryani masala, Mint leaves, Coriander leaves, Ghee, Spices
Instructions: Marinate meat, cook rice, layer with meat, and cook until done. Garnish with fried onions, mint, and coriander leaves. Add a dash of ghee and serve hot.

Ingredients: Chicken, Tomatoes, Cream, Butter, Ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri red chili powder, Garam masala, Kasuri methi, Spices
Instructions: Marinate chicken, cook in a creamy tomato sauce with butter and spices. Finish with cream, Kasuri methi, and garam masala. Garnish and serve hot.

Ingredients: Boiled potatoes, Chickpeas, Tamarind chutney, Yogurt, Chaat masala, Sev, Coriander leaves, Spices
Instructions: Mix boiled potatoes, chickpeas, tamarind chutney, yogurt, and spices. Garnish with sev and coriander leaves. Serve immediately.

Ingredients: Potatoes, Gram flour, Pav (bread), Green chilies, Ginger, Garlic, Mustard seeds, Turmeric powder, Coriander leaves, Spices
Instructions: Make spiced potato vada, place in pav, and serve with chutneys. Garnish with coriander leaves and enjoy the flavorful vada pav.

Ingredients: Potatoes, Peas, All-purpose flour, Ghee, Spices, Oil (for frying), Tamarind chutney, Mint chutney
Instructions: Prepare spiced potato and pea filling, encase in pastry, and deep fry until golden brown. Serve with tamarind and mint chutney.

Ingredients: Mixed vegetables, Pav (bread), Onions, Tomatoes, Capsicum, Pav bhaji masala, Butter, Spices
Instructions: Cook mixed vegetables, mash, and season with pav bhaji masala. Serve hot with buttered pav, diced onions, and lemon wedges.

Ingredients: Kidney beans, Onions, Tomatoes, Ginger-garlic paste, Cumin seeds, Red chili powder, Garam masala, Coriander powder, Spices
Instructions: Cook soaked kidney beans with onions, tomatoes, and spices until tender. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with rice or naan.

Ingredients: Dosa batter, Potatoes, Onions, Mustard seeds, Curry leaves, Ghee, Spices
Instructions: Make dosa batter, spread on a hot griddle, and stuff with spiced potato filling. Serve with coconut chutney and sambar.

Ingredients: Yogurt, Sugar, Water, Cardamom powder, Saffron strands, Rose water, Ice cubes
Instructions: Blend yogurt, sugar, water, and cardamom powder until smooth. Add saffron strands, rose water, and ice cubes. Serve chilled.

Ingredients: Tea leaves, Milk, Water, Ginger, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Cloves, Sugar
Instructions: Boil tea leaves, water, milk, ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and sugar. Strain and serve hot masala chai.

Ingredients: Semolina (sooji), Mint water, Tamarind water, Boiled potatoes, Chickpeas, Spices, Sev, Coriander leaves
Instructions: Prepare small puris, fill with a mixture of boiled potatoes, chickpeas, and spices. Dip in mint and tamarind water. Top with sev and coriander leaves.

Ingredients: Puffed rice, Sev, Chopped onions, Tomatoes, Boiled potatoes, Chutneys, Spices
Instructions: Mix puffed rice with sev, chopped onions, tomatoes, boiled potatoes, and chutneys. Sprinkle spices and serve immediately.

Ingredients: Mango, Yogurt, Sugar, Cardamom powder, Ice cubes
Instructions: Blend mango, yogurt, sugar, and cardamom powder until smooth. Add ice cubes and blend again. Serve chilled mango lassi.

Ingredients: Cumin seeds, Mint leaves, Tamarind water, Black salt, Rock salt, Asafoetida, Chilled water, Ice cubes
Instructions: Roast cumin seeds, crush them, and mix with mint leaves, tamarind water, black salt, rock salt, and asafoetida. Add chilled water and ice cubes. Serve jal jeera.

Ingredients: Curd, Water, Salt, Roasted cumin powder, Mint leaves, Coriander leaves, Ice cubes
Instructions: Whisk curd with water, salt, roasted cumin powder, mint leaves, and coriander leaves. Add ice cubes and serve refreshing buttermilk.
